unitNote: Values are in S$ (Second Sea currency) unless marked Proto (point-based). Fisch trading runs on three community value systems — the Proto spreadsheet, the TrueVal Discord list and Trade Hub market data — and the same item can differ 30%+ between them. We cross-check all three weekly and band the spread; when systems disagree hard, we say so instead of averaging it away.
intro: The Fisch trading value list below covers the boats, rod skins and limited cosmetics that dominate high-end trading in the THE DEEP era. Use it to sanity-check a trade before you accept — and always confirm which value system your trade partner is quoting, because 'it's worth 5M' means nothing without knowing whose list that number came from.
